The pool house has been an empty shell long enough. The plan is a hangout area on one end and a climbing wall that covers the rest of the walls and the ceiling, but first the whole space needed insulation, drywall, ventilation baffles, and a tongue and groove ceiling. I also moved some electrical and added aimable recessed lights so I won't be climbing in my own shadow.
